entities.name: Sirimiti
entities.description: Legendary sorceress of the Ice Age of Dominaria, master of crystalline magic.

entities.name: Pharon
entities.description: 400-year-old wizard who bested Sirimiti and became her lover.

entities.name: King Kjeld
entities.description: King whose wizards Sirimiti tested; forced Pharon to choose between her and the throne.

entities.name: Corbye
entities.description: Island said in legend to have been launched into the air.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: Legend claims it was created when Corbye was launched into the air.

events.summary: Sirimiti arrives at the capital of Kjeld on a feldspar sled drawn by white dire wolves.
events.quote: She arrived at the then-capital of Kjeld from somewhere in the north

events.summary: Sirimiti bests Sparkfell, Ezni Orimander and Gund the Gemcutter.
events.quote: Sparkfell , Ezni Orimander , and Gund the Gemcutter all tried their hands against her and succumbed.

events.summary: Pharon defeats Sirimiti with a slow plant growth spell.
events.quote: Only Pharon managed to best her
After their duel, they became lovers

events.summary: Kjeld forces Pharon to choose; he picks the throne and Sirimiti leaves him for good.
events.quote: Pharon chose the latter, and Sirimiti left him for good.

events.summary: A legend says Sirimiti sailed a flying ship, leading to the creation of the Null Moon; the wiki calls this false.
events.quote: This story is an established falsehood

relations.quote: After their duel, they became lovers
